name: Plate XXII: The Triple Spiral
description: Three spirals in one unbroken line, carved at the entrance stone of Newgrange five thousand years ago. Struck in Albedo: the whitening, the lunar washing of the matter. Degree of Neophyte, rank 485 of the folio. “QVOD EST SVPERIVS EST SICVT QVOD INFERIVS”: That which is above is as that which is below.
